title: tilia mandshurica var. pekinensis

This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including reducing inflammation, anxiety, and stress, as well as promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids like kaempferol and quercetin, contribute to its therapeutic properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
